---
title: "Reference"
subtitle: "Exported objects"
toc: false
---

| Object | Description |
|:--|:--|
| [`geom_cat()`](geom-cat.qmd) | Draws a cat at each observation, with seven coats, four poses and six tails. |
| [`cat_coats()`](cat-coats.qmd) | Returns the names of the supported coats. |
| [`cat_poses()`](cat-poses.qmd) | Returns the names of the supported poses. |
| [`cat_tails()`](cat-tails.qmd) | Returns the names of the supported tails. |
| [`cat_accessories()`](cat-accessories.qmd) | Returns the names of the supported accessories. |
| [`cat_moods()`](cat-moods.qmd) | Returns the names of the supported mood extras. |
| [`scale_coat_discrete()`](scale-coat.qmd) | Identity scale for the `coat` aesthetic, with a legend. |
| [`scale_pose_discrete()`](scale-pose.qmd) | Identity scale for the `pose` aesthetic, with a legend. |
| [`scale_tail_discrete()`](scale-tail.qmd) | Identity scale for the `tail` aesthetic, with a legend. |
| [`GeomCat`](geom-cat.qmd#the-ggproto-object) | The ggproto object behind the geom. |

The package also has two vignettes:

- `vignette("geom-feliscatus")` — a user guide.
- `vignette("extending-ggplot2")` — how the geom is built.

See the [extending guide](../extending.qmd) for a web version of the
second one.
